about: Animated look (how-to card): opening of a Communication Clarity guide.

scenes.narration: Listening well is a skill you can practise, not a personality trait.
Most of us think we listen well. Then a friend says, you're not listening, and we find out otherwise.
Feeling heard is one of the simplest ways people feel valued, at work, at home and in love.
Listening is a set of habits. Give full attention, hold back from interrupting, and wait before you rush to fix things.
Then reflect what you heard, and notice feelings as well as facts.
Tonight, pick one conversation and make your only goal to understand the other person, not to reply.
